notes: Register records source evidence for price claims in guides. Claims are based on asking averages, not confirmed sale prices. Sample sizes are not uniformly reported by sources.

sources.methodology: Neighborhood-level asking averages from public listing platform. Not confirmed sale prices. Negotiation affects final price.
sources.disclaimer: متوسطات أسعار معروضة في الإعلانات — مش أسعار بيع فعلي. سعر القفل بيتحدد بعد التفاوض.

unknown_fields.sample_size: Sources do not consistently report sample size (number of listings used to calculate averages). This remains unknown for all Aqarmap neighborhood averages.
unknown_fields.price_change methodology: No longitudinal methodology provided. Single-date snapshot only.
unknown_fields.unit_type_breakdown: Averages may mix apartment configurations (1BR, 2BR, etc.) without separation.
unknown_fields.amenity_impact: Impact of amenities (furnished, finishing, view) on price not quantified.

data_quality_notes: All sources are asking-price averages from public listing platforms, not confirmed transaction prices.
Sample sizes are not reported by Aqarmap, making statistical confidence unknown.
Prices vary by negotiation; the listed average is not a guaranteed transaction price.
Neighborhood averages may mask significant price variation within the area.
Data is a single-date snapshot (2026-11-02); no historical trend analysis is available.
